say:2:1013824001:2.text: Berial's appearance actually caught the attention of two Celestials...

say:3:1013824002:2.text: It's nice to see you all again, but now is not the time to linger. You should know that Berial is a Hypogean.
say:3:1013824002:2.source_cn: 诸位，又见面了。现在可不是悠哉的时候。你们应该知道，贝...
